subject: Application for Cloud Engineering Intern – Kevin Joshua L (AWS Certified | SIH Cloud Architect)
body:
Dear 1CloudHub Recruitment Team,

I am writing to express my eager interest in joining 1CloudHub as a Cloud Engineering Intern in Chennai. As an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and a dedicated cloud builder, I closely admire 1CloudHub's expertise as an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner delivering robust cloud migrations, DevOps automation, and scalable enterprise architectures.

I believe in learning by architecting real systems. In my recent Smart India Hackathon (SIH) project, "Block Train", I served as the primary Cloud Architect—designing and deploying our entire AWS backend from scratch, configuring secure VPC subnets, serverless API Gateway endpoints, Lambda compute functions, and persistent data storage under intense hackathon deadlines.

Beyond hackathons, I am executing a self-designed, public 1000-Day AI Cloud Infrastructure Journey (currently on Day 119+ of unbroken daily commits on GitHub). My hands-on AWS stack includes:
• Compute & Networking: EC2 instance hardening, IMDSv2, User Data automation, Multi-AZ VPC design, NAT Gateways, and Route Tables.
• Serverless & Integration: Lambda, SQS (DLQ), SNS, API Gateway, and EventBridge event-driven architectures.
• Storage & Cost Optimization: In-depth Amazon S3 architecture (certified in S3 Cost Optimization, Disaster Recovery, and Storage Class Lifecycle Management).
• Automation & CI/CD: Python (boto3), Linux system administration, and automated GitHub Actions pipelines.

I am based in Chennai and available to join immediately. While a stipend is welcome, my top priority is gaining real-world production cloud experience and contributing actively to your client deployments—I am completely open to an unpaid internship if that aligns best with your team's structure.

I have attached my resume for your review. I would love the opportunity to demonstrate my technical knowledge through a practical assessment or technical conversation.

Warm regards,

subject: Application: Cloud Storage & Infrastructure Intern – Kevin Joshua L (AWS Certified | S3 & BCDR Focus)
body:
Dear Vembu Careers Team,

I am writing to apply for a Cloud Storage & Infrastructure Intern position at Vembu Technologies at Chennai One IT SEZ. Having studied enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions, I have immense respect for Vembu's BDRSuite and your leadership in hybrid cloud backup and data protection.

My core technical focus aligns directly with your domain. I have completed comprehensive AWS certifications in Amazon S3 Storage Classes, S3 Cost Optimization, and S3 Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BCDR). Applying these principles practically, I engineered an Automated S3 Cloud Backup Tool in Python that performs intelligent incremental synchronization via MD5 hash and ETag comparison, reducing redundant bandwidth while enforcing lifecycle management.

Furthermore, as the dedicated Cloud Architect for our Smart India Hackathon (SIH) project, "Block Train", I architected our AWS backend infrastructure—implementing fault-tolerant storage, serverless compute, and secure data access under demanding conditions.

Key capabilities I offer your engineering team:
